5.0 removed the admin's GeoModelAdmin, OSMGeoAdmin and django.contrib.gis.admin.OpenLayersWidget, leaving `GISModelAdmin` (`django/contrib/gis/admin/options.py:GISModelAdmin`).

5.1 told the Z and M dimensions apart: `OGRGeometry.is_3d` and `OGRGeometry.is_measured` read them, `OGRGeometry.set_3d` and `OGRGeometry.set_measured` add or drop them, and points and lines give their M coordinates (`django/contrib/gis/gdal/geometries.py:OGRGeometry.set_measured`).

The curved ones set `OGRGeometry.geos_support` false, and their `OGRGeometry.geos` raises `GEOSException` (`django/contrib/gis/geos/geometry.py:GEOSGeometryBase.__init__`, `django/contrib/gis/gdal/geometries.py:OGRGeometry.geos`).

Both need GEOS 3.12 (`django/contrib/gis/geos/geometry.py:GEOSGeometryBase.hasm`; [Geometries in Python: GEOS and GDAL](../contrib/geometries.md#geosgeometry)).
